The Korea Drone EXPO 2024 has been taking place in Songdo Convensia from 9 to 11 May 2024 hosted by the MOLIT and Inchon Metropolitan City under the topic of ‘Drones Come True’ along with Exhibition, World Drone Lightshow, Global Drone Conference, and International DroneSoccer Festa, etc. featuring the current developing state of Korean drone industry and future endeavors, as well as providing successful business showcases and support program for companies seeking to expand into the international market.
